summary.headline: Chapters on Syzygies and Eclipses
summary.text: Catalog entry for folios 18–20 of a Florentine astrological manuscript, listing chapters on calculating conjunctions and full moons, mean and true solar and lunar epochs, syzygy times and places, lunar anomalous motion and latitude, and solar and lunar eclipses. The tables are transformed from Ptolemy’s great syntaxis, with methods involving zodiacal signs, apogee, tropical correction, and ecliptic limits.
